description: Observed in worktree BenchBox.wt-pr-text, whose branch was behind develop after develop replaced _project/scripts/vendor/todo_db-0.9.1-py3-none-any.whl with 0.10.1. make comment-policy-check failed first with a missing-file error for the 0.9.1 wheel and, after I restored that file from the branch, with 'immutable dependency binding changed: _project/scripts/vendor/todo_db-0.9.1-py3-none-any.whl'. Neither message says the branch is behind develop. Building on a current develop base made the check pass. The root cause (why the ownership binding compares against a wheel the base no longer has) was not investigated.
